jobs.title: Digital Channel Engineer (Bank)
jobs.description:
Company Description
Avanza Solutions, founded in 2000, is a global provider of innovative digital platforms and services that enable organizations to drive digital transformation. The company has established itself as a leading digital innovation hub, specializing in solutions for digital banking, customer experience management, artificial intelligence, blockchain, smart city applications, business automation, and cognitive platforms. Avanza delivers people-centric, automation-driven solutions to clients across banking, finance, telecommunications, insurance, pharmaceuticals, government, and other sectors. By deploying advanced technologies and integrated digital ecosystems, the company helps enterprises transform their operational, financial, and functional performance worldwide.
Role Description
The Digital Channel Engineer (Bank) is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This position is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining digital banking channels and related applications, ensuring a secure, reliable, and user-friendly customer experience. Day-to-day tasks include implementing new features, integrating external systems and services, troubleshooting technical issues, and optimizing performance of web and mobile banking platforms. The engineer collaborates closely with product, security, and infrastructure teams to meet business requirements, comply with regulatory standards, and support production deployments. The role also involves documenting technical solutions, participating in code reviews, and contributing to continuous improvement of development and integration practices.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Software Development skills, with experience in designing, coding, testing, and deploying enterprise applications.
Candidates should possess solid Programming skills, ideally in languages commonly used in digital banking channels (such as Java, .NET, JavaScript, or similar).
Candidates should possess relevant Electronics and Verilog skills when working with embedded or hardware-related banking systems and interfaces.
Candidates should possess Integration skills for connecting banking platforms with core banking systems, third-party services, APIs, and middleware.
Experience in digital banking, financial services, or payments platforms is highly beneficial.
Knowledge of security best practices, regulatory requirements, and high-availability system design is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
On behalf of a client, a technology company delivering advanced software solutions across financial services, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
.

The Role

You'll join the engineering team working on a blockchain-based FinTech platform. Specifically, you will:
Design and build robust, high-performance backend services in C# / .NET Core 8
Work on cloud-native systems on AWS
Own PostgreSQL schema design, query optimization, and data integrity
Build and maintain integrations with KYC providers, crypto custodians, and KYT platforms
Make architectural decisions on a system where security, performance, and correctness are critical
Improve CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and DevOps practices
Mentor teammates and collaborate with experienced specialists across several technical disciplines

Who We're Looking For

You're an engineer who:
Takes genuine ownership and exercises sound judgment
Holds well-reasoned technical opinions and can defend them
Favors simple, correct solutions that ship over perfect ones that don't
Sees seniority as a matter of judgment rather than years of experience

What You Bring

5–7 years building production software used by real customers
Deep C# / .NET expertise
Strong PostgreSQL skills
Hands-on AWS experience
Solid understanding of microservices, API design, and distributed systems trade-offs
Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services in regulated environments
Comfort with CI/CD, containerization, and modern DevOps practices
Good judgment on when to build, when to buy, and when to simplify

Nice to Have

Experience in FinTech, blockchain, or crypto
Familiarity with KYC / KYT / AML workflows or providers
Docker / Kubernetes (EKS, AKS)
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep)
Event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus)
Observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana)
A strong interest in developer experience and security

What's on Offer

Competitive salary and performance bonus
Retirement and medical benefits
Additional perks and allowances
Hybrid working
A collaborative, growing team of experienced engineers
The chance to work on cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced environment
A culture of innovation and continuous learning
